title: Microsoft Teams: recently used emojis and reactions sync across devices
summary: The rollout, default state and absence of a documented sync switch are supported by Microsoft's notice and the documentation checked. Two minor corrections remain: acknowledge the general Teams licence requirement and rate the impact as high because the default change affects all supported Teams users.
